title: Tweet: the NGA tracks nonstructured light-energy craft
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Tweet: the NGA tracks nonstructured light-energy craft, about present at worldwide, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: National Geospatial Agency is able to keep track of all those nonstructured light energy craft flying around the world

plain: A man described as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, read out on a podcast a message he posted to the tech billionaire Elon Musk. In it he says the National Geospatial Agency, a US agency that maps the world from satellite images, can track all the "nonstructured light energy craft" flying around the planet. If true, it would mean the government is constantly watching strange craft made of light all over the world.
